notes_for_editor: No source found gives a build date, builder, use or condition. The Forest Lookouts listing is the only fire-lookout link; OpenStreetMap tags the structure as an observation tower, so it may not be a fire lookout. Town disagrees: New Milford (Forest Lookouts; TopoZone's New Milford map area) against Sherman (ExpertGPS). Elevation differs slightly: 242 m (OpenStreetMap) against 248 m (TopoZone). Mindat and the trail sites (AllTrails, TripAdvisor) were blocked or not tied to the tower, so they are not cited. The firetower.org Connecticut register lists eight sites, none of them this one.
